issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.author should be a String, but the solution defines the author property as a Bool. This type mismatch contradicts the specification and will confuse students mapping the textual requirements to the implementation (and is semantically incorrect for an author field).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book.author property type from Bool to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift (e.g. `let author: String`) and ensure all Book initializations in the repository pass String values for authors. This aligns the code with the problem specification and expected usage in Client.
